sample_bytes_upper_bound_algorithm: max over trusted runtime variants {SOLO, SEC} of sum unique runtime sample file byte sizes; variants are mutually exclusive at run time
decoded_float32_stereo_algorithm: max over trusted runtime variants {SOLO, SEC} of sum unique runtime sample frame_count * 2 output channels * 4-byte float32; mono sources are expanded to stereo by read_audio_float; variants are mutually exclusive at run time
说明: 一件乐器两种编制变体,各用不同采样库:SOLO=No Budget Orchestra 独奏,SEC=SSO 第一小提琴声部。下面按变体分别冻结其真实加载的采样。

SOLO.decoded_float32_stereo_algorithm: sum unique runtime sample frame_count * 2 output channels * 4-byte float32; mono sources are expanded to stereo by read_audio_float
SOLO.sample_enumeration: constructed the instrument and walked its loaded sample regions; hashes cover exactly the files the engine reads at run time
SOLO.sample_set_hash_algorithm: sort unique asset-root-relative UTF-8 paths; concatenate lowercase '<sha256>  <path>\n>'; SHA-256 the UTF-8 bytes

SEC.decoded_float32_stereo_algorithm: sum unique runtime sample frame_count * 2 output channels * 4-byte float32; mono sources are expanded to stereo by read_audio_float
SEC.sample_enumeration: constructed the instrument and walked its loaded sample regions; hashes cover exactly the files the engine reads at run time
SEC.sample_set_hash_algorithm: sort unique asset-root-relative UTF-8 paths; concatenate lowercase '<sha256>  <path>\n>'; SHA-256 the UTF-8 bytes
